answer.reason: The verses tell what was made of the image and what happened to it: it was made from the silver, taken by the Danites, and set up at Dan.

clauses.english: was made by a founder from silver Micah's mother dedicated to the LORD
clauses.quote: who made thereof a graven image and a molten image

clauses.english: was taken by the Danites from Micah's house
clauses.quote: came in thither, and took the graven image

clauses.english: was set up by the children of Dan in their city
clauses.quote: the children of Dan set up the graven image

doubts: JDG 18:14 and 18:20 name the image only in lists of items or in the priest's taking it; left uncited as minor.
